candidate_evidence.quote: FG001 is an investigational optical imaging agent administered as a single intravenous dose prior to neurosurgical tumor resection to support intraoperative visualization of malignant tissue under near-infrared fluorescence guidance.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No prior tumor-specific treatment, including surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or investigational therapy (i.e., newly diagnosed, treatment-naïve HGG).

coder_notes: Diagnostic-only trial: FG001 is an optical imaging agent for NIR fluorescence-guided resection, so no candidate (S6 = no_pharmacological_candidate). Population mixes WHO CNS5 grade 3/4 gliomas including glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype. Note internal inconsistency: inclusion lists IDH-mutant astrocytoma/oligodendroglioma as eligible but exclusion 19a lists IDH-mutant tumours as screen failures. IDH not coded as an eligibility requirement because IDH-mutant histologies are listed as eligible in inclusion. Temozolomide is mentioned only as follow-up compliance (not a registered or protocol-given intervention) and is not listed (R9). 'PK analysis' concerns the diagnostic agent, not a candidate.
